# Campaniles

> Campaniles is an independent, community-first media platform for computer science and information technology. It is a place to publish, read, and discuss technical writing, news, and analysis without the noise and incentives of ad-driven feeds. The project is free and open source under the Apache License 2.0.

Principles:
- Community first: the people who read and write here shape the platform.
- Independent: no corporate gatekeeping, no pay-to-play ranking.
- Open source: the code is public, auditable, and built in the open.
- Technically focused: content is for and by the CS/IT community.

Audience: software engineers, students, researchers, and technologists who want substantive technical content and discussion.

## Site

- [Home](https://campaniles.com/): Landing page for the platform.

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://campaniles.com/legal/terms): Terms that govern use of the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://campaniles.com/legal/privacy): How Campaniles collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Cookie Policy](https://campaniles.com/legal/cookies): How and why Campaniles uses cookies.

## Technical

- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4 with shadcn/ui components.
- Internationalization: next-intl (English default, unprefixed root).

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/campaniles/campaniles): Public source code (Apache 2.0).
